$comment: Layer 4 - claims this repository cannot prove on its own: a physical device, the App Store, an external service. Each entry is a dated statement of what a human observed, with an expiry and a re-verify recipe, referenced from a governed document with <!-- vt-claim: attested <id> -->. An entry past its budget FAILS the gate, and so does one no document references. Device and store claims are NOT auto-detected from prose - the marker is how such a claim enters the ledger.

entries.claim: versionCode 10301 (1.3.0) sits on the Play alpha track as a DRAFT release for uk.vettrack.app, so 'blocked until the first AAB is uploaded' is no longer why the App Signing certificate is unavailable. Re-verify with the authenticated gplay CLI: `gplay edits create --package uk.vettrack.app`, then `gplay tracks list --package uk.vettrack.app --edit <id>` — expect track 'alpha' carrying release 1.3.0 with versionCodes ['10301'].
entries.evidence: Play Developer API via the authenticated gplay CLI
entries.attestedBy: agent run 2026-08-31, credentials in ~/keys (not in this repo)

entries.claim: The authenticated gplay CLI cannot read the Play App Signing certificate: no signing/cert command exists, and the sha256 returned by `gplay bundles list` is the digest of the uploaded AAB, not the certificate fingerprint. The SHA-256 for well-known-assetlinks.ts is therefore Console-only, owner-side. Re-verify with `gplay --help` and `gplay bundles --help`; this entry fails the day a certificate read is added, at which point the row becomes an agent step.
entries.evidence: gplay --help command surface; gplay bundles list output shape

entries.claim: The Railway project VetTrack has a single environment, production; the Worker service carries every REQUIRED_IN_PRODUCTION name plus NODE_ENV=production (DB_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID, S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as references to VetTrack's values) and no VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; the VetTrack service no longer has NIXPACKS_NODE_VERSION nor the unprefixed ACCESS_KEY_ID/BUCKET/ENDPOINT/REGION/SECRET_ACCESS_KEY/RAILWAY_BUCKET_ID twins and does have ANDROID_PLAY_SIGNING_SHA256; the staged patch is empty. Re-verify (names only, never values): `npx @railway/cli@5.26.0 environment list`, then `railway variables --service Worker --json | jq 'keys'` and `railway variables --service VetTrack --json | jq 'keys'`, and the Railway MCP get-staged-changes on environment 63549599.
entries.evidence: Railway CLI variable listings (names only) and GraphQL environmentStagedChanges, read by the operations session of 2026-09-10/11

entries.claim: https://vettrack.uk/.well-known/assetlinks.json serves exactly two sha256_cert_fingerprints for uk.vettrack.app: the UPLOAD_KEY_CERT_FINGERPRINT constant from server/lib/well-known-assetlinks.ts (93:34:4C:4B:9F:2D:22:CC:61:DA:0C:35:71:CF:98:E5:85:22:A3:0A:CA:B8:98:17:2A:28:E7:FC:9F:82:5C:83) and the value of the ANDROID_PLAY_SIGNING_SHA256 variable, which is the Play App Signing key (C4:17:D1:FA:83:F3:4A:7C:C9:4E:63:14:39:ED:FE:FD:13:F0:B3:2F:D2:BA:D5:65:A8:7C:CC:78:5F:B9:CE:3E). This attests what the endpoint serves; it does NOT attest that the constant equals the Play Console upload key (Play Console lists 38:31:8A:…:4F:5F there — an open owner decision recorded in docs/runbooks/o2-eas-keystore.md). Re-verify by comparing normalized values, not a count: `curl -s https://vettrack.uk/.well-known/assetlinks.json | jq -r '.[0].target.sha256_cert_fingerprints[] | ascii_upcase' | sort` must print exactly `C4:17:D1:FA:83:F3:4A:7C:C9:4E:63:14:39:ED:FE:FD:13:F0:B3:2F:D2:BA:D5:65:A8:7C:CC:78:5F:B9:CE:3E` and `93:34:4C:4B:9F:2D:22:CC:61:DA:0C:35:71:CF:98:E5:85:22:A3:0A:CA:B8:98:17:2A:28:E7:FC:9F:82:5C:83` (one per line, sorted), and the second must equal the output of `grep -o '"[0-9A-F:]\{95\}"' server/lib/well-known-assetlinks.ts`.
entries.evidence: curl of the live endpoint after the 2026-09-10 redeploy

entries.claim: The dboy3156 GitHub account is deleted, and these five repositories exist under exposwifty31: vettrack, VetTrack---RN-Migration-, VetTrack-Updated-, shifts, and VetTrack-legacy (the former dboy3156/VetTrack). Nothing more is claimed about what depends on what.
